visualCharacteristics.purpose: Product summary shown beside the gallery: product copy on the left, price, add-to-basket CTA and icon feature pills on the right
visualCharacteristics.summary: Two-column product summary: title/description left, price + full-width CTA + icon pills right; stacks on mobile

contentPattern.summary: Side-by-side product summary: title, subtitle, description (left) and price, Add to basket CTA, 2 icon feature pills (right)
contentPattern.structure: one row, two cells; cell 1: rating text, H1 product title, subtitle paragraph, description paragraphs; cell 2: price paragraph, CTA link (rendered as a full-width button), one paragraph per feature pill (icon image + label)

reuseGuidance: Use for product detail summaries pairing descriptive copy with a purchase panel. For generic side-by-side text/image layouts use the base columns block.
